sources.title: PointDiT - haofeixu.github.io
sources.snippet: PointDiT is a minimalist pixel-space Diffusion Transformer that predicts a dense 3D point map from a single RGB image. No VAE, no hybrid network. Sharper geometry, single or multi step. ICML 2026.

sources.title: Haofei Xu (@haofeixu) on X
sources.snippet: PointDiT achieves high-quality 3D geometry in just a single step, and running more steps makes the fine-grained structures even sharper. Play with the results interactively in our project page! haofeixu.github.io/pointdit/ Read the paper

sources.title: [2607.02515] PointDiT: Pixel-Space Diffusion for Monocular Geometry ...
sources.snippet: State-of-the-art single-image 3D reconstruction methods often rely on complex hybrid architectures and loss functions, or compress geometry into latent spaces in order to leverage pre-trained latent diffusion models.
